answer: The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, held in escrow until finality, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. By the whisper of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Each submission hangs on the vine of a task receipt, and the beacon is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce.
